items.scope: Vulnerability coordination for vulnerabilities in all products reported to CERT-In in accordance with our vulnerability coordination role as a CERT. Vulnerability assignments for vulnerabilities impacting all products designed, developed, and manufactured in India.
Yandex issues only.
Samsung Mobile Galaxy products, personal computers, and related services only.

All products released by Teradyne Robotics subsidiaries, Universal Robots (UR) and Mobile Industrial Robots (MiR), including both actively supported and end-of-life/end-of-service products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software identified by Teradyne Robotics that are outside the scope of another CNA.
Pegasystems products only.
Vulnerability assignment related to FSI’s vulnerability coordination role in the South Korea financial sector that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities related to products of Mitsubishi Electric Group.
Check Point Security Gateways product line only, and any vulnerabilities discovered by Check Point that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Johnson Controls products only.
Vulnerabilities in software discovered by NCSC-FI, and vulnerabilities reported to NCSC-FI for coordinated disclosure, which are not in another CNA’s scope.
All vulnerabilities on software products that our company provides, including KNIME Analytics Platform, KNIME Server, and KNIME Hub.
Eaton issues only.
All Temporal Technologies software.
Third-party products he researches that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Zscaler issues only.
Vulnerabilities identified in Wiz products, and vulnerabilities discovered by, or reported to, Wiz that are not in another CNA’s scope.

All CyberDanube products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party hardware/software discovered by CyberDanube or partners actively engaged in vulnerability research coordination, which are not within the scope of another CNA.
Roche’s medical technology products.
Third-party products it researches.
All HashiCorp products and projects unless covered by another CNA’s scope.
All dotCMS product services including the vulnerabilities reported in our open source core located at https://github.com/dotCMS/core.

WordPress Plugins, Themes, and Core Vulnerabilities discovered by, or reported to, the Wordfence/Defiant team.
All Armis products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Armis that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All Honeywell products.
All ISC.org projects.

All HYPR products only.
All Proofpoint products.

Hitachi products excluding Hitachi Energy and Hitachi Vantara products.
Vulnerabilities in AMI firmware and software products, as well as vulnerabilities discovered by AMI that are not covered by another CNA scope.
All upKeeper Solutions products, excluding end-of-life (EOL) as listed in the upKeeper Solutions End of Life Policy.

All OpenText products (including Carbonite, Zix, Micro Focus, others).

All Cisco products, and any third-party research targets that are not in another CNA’s scope. Switzerland Government Common Vulnerability Program.
All HCL products only.
Vulnerabilities in software discovered by DIVD, and vulnerabilities reported to DIVD for coordinated disclosure, which are not in another CNA’s scope.
Transport Layer Security (TLS) and Cryptographic issues found in wolfSSL products.
